repairs.diagnosis: The importer references the removed app.db module, causing the observed failures. Its engine.connect() context also lacks a commit under SQLAlchemy 2.0, so successful inserts would be rolled back on connection exit.

changes.reason: Use the relocated storage engine and commit the import transaction before returning its count, ensuring imported bookmarks persist across processes.

repairs.summary: Update the importer to use app.storage.db and commit bulk inserts with engine.begin().

commits.subject: Verify bulk imports survive a fresh process
